digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 verify gate / LLM structured output
propositions: Exact-model-id row in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES sets native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6, flipping from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput and causing rebar to send JSON Schema to Bedrock for grammar compilation
Verification contracts carry 22-36 optional parameters (all fields have default=, making them optional in JSON Schema), exceeding Anthropic's 24-parameter cap and 180-second compilation timeout
HTTP 400 ValidationException 'Grammar compilation timed out' degrades every finding to no-verification, landing reviews as INDETERMINATE and unsigned, affecting both plan-review and code-review gates
Output_mode must gate NativeOutput on schema complexity by recursively counting optional and union-typed parameters across resolved schema including $defs, items, and nested properties
Schema-complexity rejection must be classified distinctly from generic provider outage and trigger fallback to PromptedOutput path rather than failing closed
